title: Database connection pool exhaustion at 30 concurrent users
evidence: P95 latency rose from 180 ms to 4,200 ms as concurrent users exceeded 30. Pool size is 10; all 10 connections were in use at the inflection point. HTTP 504 error rate 0.8% at 50 concurrent users. CPU 45%, memory stable — server resources not constrained.
impact: Any traffic spike above ~25 concurrent active searches will cause visible latency degradation and a proportion of timeouts. Current peak production traffic estimate would cause widespread user-facing errors.
remediation: Increase database connection pool size to 50. Add a read replica and route search queries there to separate read load from write load. Set a connection acquire timeout of 2 seconds and return a 503 with Retry-After rather than queuing indefinitely.
verification_steps: Re-run the 50-user load test after pool size increase
Confirm P95 latency stays below 500 ms at 50 concurrent users
Verify pool utilization metric is visible in monitoring dashboard
